blocked_reasons.reason: no provider without network or cost configured

remotion.setup: Remotion needs an npm install (network) and a company licence for larger teams; this collection ships no copy and never installs one.

deck-runtime.setup: The React deck runtime (a Vite app with a browser PDF driver) is a user-supplied runtime and is not shipped here; slides use the Chrome adapter instead.

playwright.setup: No Playwright driver is shipped or used; install one yourself if you want browser automation outside this module.

hosted-plan-service.setup: The hosted plan and recap publishing path sends content to an outside service; it is never called from here.

atlas-build.setup: The operator atlas template and its build step run under a JavaScript runtime and are not shipped; the atlas adapter draws a plain SVG page instead.

infographic-render.setup: The third-party infographic renderer is excluded by the collection's source licence record and needs a Playwright browser install; not shipped.

plan-local-files.setup: The upstream plan and recap local-files mode is a skill workflow, not a renderer this collection ships; the visuals adapter draws its own pages.

illustration-backends.setup: Every illustration backend needs network and a hosted image model (quota or a paid key). Configure a provider yourself and pass the explicit allow flags.
